set.body: See docs/plans/terminal-workspace.md, V2. Add daemon-owned deduplicated inspect requests and expiring selected-file log leases, a bounded directory snapshot primitive (current op_ls enumerates/sorts all names), cached browsing with explicit partial coverage, and job-to-log/output links. Add shared file-edit and transfer producers including CLI rsync adapters. No background recursive scans, validators, or remote mutations. Test giant/changing directories, stale pagination, symlinks, rotation, hostile terminal text, unavailable paths, transfer outcomes, cache/byte/deadline bounds and shared RPC counts.
set.title: V2: bounded workspace files, logs, and transfer activity
